name: code-review-workflow
description: Multi-agent code review with specialized reviewers

tasks.prompt: List all modified files in this PR using git diff --name-only. Return just the file paths, one per line.
Review these files for security vulnerabilities: {{list-files}}. Focus on: SQL injection, XSS, auth bypasses, secrets exposure, insecure dependencies.
Review these files for performance issues: {{list-files}}. Focus on: inefficient algorithms, N+1 queries, memory leaks, blocking operations.
Review these files for code style and best practices: {{list-files}}. Focus on: naming conventions, code organization, documentation, test coverage.

Create a comprehensive code review report combining:

Security Findings:
{{security-review}}

Performance Findings:
{{performance-review}}

Style Findings:
{{style-review}}

Provide:
1. Executive summary
2. Critical issues (must fix)
3. Important issues (should fix)
4. Suggestions (nice to have)
5. Overall assessment
